title: Tiny, cute house
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <rect x='20' y='82' width='60' height='8' rx='4' fill='#2a5a3a' />

  <!-- main house body -->
  <rect x='28' y='45' width='44' height='37' rx='3' fill='#f5d76e' />

  <!-- house body highlight (left side) -->
  <rect x='28' y='45' width='8' height='37' rx='3' fill='#ffe89a' />

  <!-- roof -->
  <polygon points='50,25 20,48 80,48' fill='#e05a4e' />

  <!-- roof lighter shade (left half) -->
  <polygon points='50,25 20,48 50,48' fill='#ff7a6e' />

  <!-- chimney -->
  <rect x='62' y='28' width='8' height='18' rx='1' fill='#b84a40' />
  <rect x='61' y='26' width='10' height='5' rx='1' fill='#d06058' />

  <!-- door -->
  <rect x='43' y='60' width='14' height='22' rx='2' fill='#8b5e3c' />
  <!-- door knob -->
  <circle cx='53' cy='72' r='2' fill='#ffe89a' />

  <!-- window left -->
  <rect x='31' y='52' width='10' height='10' rx='1' fill='#5bc0eb' />
  <line x1='36' y1='52' x2='36' y2='62' stroke='#8b5e3c' stroke-width='1.5' />
  <line x1='31' y1='57' x2='41' y2='57' stroke='#8b5e3c' stroke-width='1.5' />

  <!-- window right -->
  <rect x='59' y='52' width='10' height='10' rx='1' fill='#5bc0eb' />
  <line x1='64' y1='52' x2='64' y2='62' stroke='#8b5e3c' stroke-width='1.5' />
  <line x1='59' y1='57' x2='69' y2='57' stroke='#8b5e3c' stroke-width='1.5' />

  <!-- window glows -->
  <rect x='32' y='53' width='4' height='4' rx='1' fill='#a8e4ff' />
  <rect x='60' y='53' width='4' height='4' rx='1' fill='#a8e4ff' />

  <!-- little bush left -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='80' r='6' fill='#4caf50' />
  <circle cx='20' cy='78' r='4' fill='#66bb6a' />

  <!-- little bush right -->
  <circle cx='76' cy='80' r='6' fill='#4caf50' />
  <circle cx='80' cy='78' r='4' fill='#66bb6a' />

  <!-- path stones -->
  <rect x='44' y='83' width='12' height='4' rx='2' fill='#a0a0a0' />
  <rect x='42' y='88' width='14' height='4' rx='2' fill='#909090' />

  <!-- smoke from chimney -->
  <circle cx='67' cy='22' r='3' fill='#d0d0d0' opacity='0.8' />
  <circle cx='70' cy='16' r='2.5' fill='#d0d0d0' opacity='0.6' />
  <circle cx='68' cy='10' r='2' fill='#d0d0d0' opacity='0.4' />
</svg>
